bug.title: POST /api/picture is behind the Grok login gate
bug.notes: TRACKER_ORIGIN is https://light-bamboo-earth-cloud.grok.me. Design POST of raw jpeg to /api/picture?project=Asteria&scope=discussion&target=FEAT-027 returned HTTP 401 and gate HTML ("Continue with Grok"), not JSON {ok,name}. Same gate on GET of the origin. Grok cannot store concept art until the picture route is reachable without that gate, or the sandbox has a session. Protocol followed: discussion text posted, no GitHub binaries.
